 We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust \& Safety and Anti\-Abuse program from the ground up.  You understand that Trust \& Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes.  You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations.
